identity.fantasy: A lunar shield-knight who turns a huge mana pool into armor, flat mitigation, block windows, star-marked area threat, and repeated Starburst resets.
identity.one_line: A mana-scaling tank that converts Strength into Intellect, applies Stars through AoE attacks, and consumes them to reset Starburst. It has strong block windows, a maximum-mana shield, and flat mitigation from mana. Recent opinions conflict sharply on its endgame durability, so its identity is clear but its comparative rank is not.

mechanics.core_loop: Apply Scattered Stars through Starsweep and other area attacks, consume those stars to reset Starburst, keep the mana-scaled shield and block package healthy, and rotate Crystal Shield, Moonveil Screen, Celestial Guard, or Moonlit Bulwark around dangerous damage.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: apply scattered stars through starsweep and other area attacks, consume those stars to reset starburst, keep the mana-scaled shield and block package healthy, and rotate crystal shield, moonveil screen, celestial guard, or moonlit bulwark around dangerous damage.

avoid_if.text: You want a conventional high-health tank or dislike balancing one resource between offense and defense.
You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that most defensive state lives on the tank, but keeping star debuffs and area coverage on the active pack matters for resets.

praise.theme: Players praise the active block gameplay, moon-throwing fantasy, leveling AoE, and full-health large pulls.

frustrations.theme: Late-July and August players sharply criticize its endgame health and comparative durability.

contested.theme: Moon Guard has the strongest unresolved sentiment conflict in the pilot: strong leveling and some positive tank reports versus severe level-60 criticism.

gaps: Comparative level-60 mitigation requires controlled logs.
Conflicting durability reports remain unresolved by design.

claims.text: Current Starcaller discussion sharply conflicts: some players report excellent leveling AoE, active block gameplay, full-health large pulls, and strong mana-scaled mitigation, while later level-60 comments call Moon Guard squishy or the weakest tank compared with Venomancer, Templar, and Witch Hunter.
claims.notes: The source contains later comments across patches and no normalized gear comparison.

claims.text: The August Mythic inventory lists 69 Moon Guard records. The DPS compilation's 1,428 value is tank off-role damage and cannot rank tank durability.
claims.notes: Representation and off-role damage do not resolve durability.

claims.text: Moon Guard is a mana-block tank whose distinctive skill test is preserving a shared offensive and defensive resource while cycling star resets and layered mitigation.
claims.notes: Playstyle classification.

claims.text: Moon Guard can compound a resource mistake because excessive offensive mana spending may weaken the same pool that supports shields and flat mitigation.
claims.notes: Exact scaling and safe mana floor are not measured.
